narratives.name: Practice Intent
narratives.description: Why partner go-to-market execution matters for Red Hat-partner ecosystem success.

narrativeContexts.context: Red Hat technology partners need structured frameworks to execute sales plays, manage deals, and deliver technical engagements within the partner ecosystem program.

Enable partners to independently drive pipeline through co-branded demand generation, register and protect deals through the deal registration system, and deliver funded technical activities that validate technology fit.

The practice defines partner-specific GTM execution activities spanning campaign management, deal registration lifecycle, co-selling coordination, and funded technical engagement delivery with integrated incentive and compliance tracking.

Partners generate attributable pipeline, achieve deal protection with competitive discounts, earn activity points for tier advancement, and establish incumbency for renewal business while contributing to ecosystem-wide GTM amplification.

narratives.name: Demand Campaign Execution

activities.name: Register Partner Deal
activities.description: Partner seller identifies and registers a sales opportunity through the Red Hat deal registration system, while the Red Hat deal desk validates eligibility, approves discount structures, and activates deal protection.

given: Partner is enrolled in eligible module (Resell or Sell With) with deal registration system access
Partner sales team has completed required seller credentials

test.name: Deal registration verification
test.description: Verifies partner submits deal registration and receives protection with discount eligibility.
when: Partner identifies a qualifying customer opportunity meeting tier eligibility, deal size threshold, and route to market requirements
then: Deal registration is submitted via Red Hat Partner Connect with all required fields completed
180-day deal protection period is initiated upon approval with discount rates and activity points confirmed
Financial partner is locked and incumbency eligibility is established

examples.name: Distribution Route New Business Registration
examples.description: A partner registers a new customer opportunity through the distribution route.
given: Partner seller has identified a new customer interested in container platform technology, estimated at $50K ACV, with no prior Red Hat relationship
when: The seller submits deal registration selecting distribution route to market, new business deal type, and the container platform technology area
then: Registration is approved with 180-day protection, 1,050 activity points are awarded (Resell), deal registration discount of 25% commercial is confirmed, and the partner begins structured pre-sales engagement

examples.name: Cloud Route Cross-Sell Registration
examples.description: A partner registers a cross-sell opportunity through the cloud route.
given: Partner has an existing customer with infrastructure subscription looking to expand into security technology, $30K estimated incremental ACV
when: The seller submits deal registration selecting cloud route to market, cross-sell deal type, and the security technology area
then: Registration is approved with deal protection confirmed, activity points are awarded (900 Sell With for cloud route), and the cross-sell opportunity is linked to the existing customer account

narratives.name: Deal Registration and Protection
narratives.description: How partners qualify, register, and secure deal protection for customer opportunities.

narrativeContexts.context: Partners identify customer opportunities aligned to Red Hat sales plays and need to secure deal protection through the registration system.
Evaluate the opportunity against eligibility criteria (tier, deal size, route to market, product eligibility, country matching), and submit registration through Red Hat Partner Connect.

Submit deal registration with customer information, technology area, estimated value, and engagement plan; Red Hat deal desk validates eligibility, approves discount structures, and initiates the 180-day protection period.

Partner receives deal protection commitments, confirmed discount rates (25% Commercial / 12% Other), activity points (1,050 Resell / 900 Sell-With), and established incumbency eligibility for future renewal business.

activities.name: Execute Partner Sales Play
activities.description: Partner sales team translates Red Hat-defined sales play guides into customer engagements while Red Hat provides co-selling support, specialist resources, and competitive positioning guidance.

given: Red Hat sales play with partner-specific guide is published and available
Partner sales team has completed required seller credentials for play technology areas

test.name: Sales play execution verification
test.description: Verifies partner uses structured play approach to advance customer engagements.
when: Partner has registered deals under an active sales play and is executing the sales cycle under deal protection
then: Pre-sales activities are conducted with Red Hat co-selling support engaged where appropriate
Customer evaluation progresses with technology validation evidence supporting Red Hat selection
Competitive positioning combines Red Hat platform advantages with partner domain expertise

examples.name: Infrastructure Play Execution with Partner Domain Overlay
examples.description: A financial services partner overlays domain expertise onto an infrastructure modernization play.
given: Partner specializes in financial services infrastructure and is executing a Red Hat infrastructure modernization sales play with a banking customer
when: The partner seller uses the play's Customer Lens and overlays partner-specific financial services expertise including regulatory compliance knowledge and banking-specific deployment patterns
then: The customer recognizes both the Red Hat technology value proposition and the partner's domain-specific implementation capability, generating a qualified opportunity registered with play theme attribution

examples.name: Multi-TDP Play Execution
examples.description: A partner executes a multi-technology play showing an integrated solution story.
given: A Red Hat sales play spans three technology areas, each represented by a TDP, and the partner has technical seller credentials across all three areas
when: The partner seller executes the play with a customer by sequencing TDP-specific demonstrations across the three technology areas
then: The customer sees an integrated solution story rather than three separate product pitches, the partner earns activity points for each demonstration, and the deal registration captures the full multi-technology opportunity value

narratives.name: Sales Play Customer Engagement
narratives.description: How partners translate Red Hat sales play frameworks into effective customer engagements with co-selling support.

narrativeContexts.context: Partner sellers have registered deals and are actively executing sales cycles within the deal protection period, needing to advance opportunities through customer evaluation.
Translate Red Hat sales play messaging, competitive positioning, and TDP content into customer engagements while coordinating co-selling motions with Red Hat.
Conduct pre-sales activities, deploy competitive positioning, manage deal protection extensions, and coordinate with Red Hat specialist resources for complex opportunities.
Deals progress through the sales cycle with validated technology fit, competitive differentiation, and customer commitment toward closure within the protection period.

activities.name: Deliver Partner Technical Activity

test.name: Technical activity delivery verification
test.description: Verifies partner executes funded technical activity with customer engagement and proof of performance.
when: Partner has an approved fund request for a technical engagement aligned to a registered deal and TDP technology area
then: Technical activity is executed within approved parameters with customer engagement completed
Proof of performance documentation is collected and claim is submitted within quarterly deadline
Activity points are earned and technical artifacts contribute to TDP proof point library

examples.name: Large Proof of Concept Execution
examples.description: A partner delivers a large PoC for an enterprise deployment scenario.
given: Partner has approved funding for a large PoC
when: Partner technical team executes the PoC over multiple weeks validating Red Hat technology fit for an enterprise deployment scenario
then: Customer receives validated deployment evidence, partner earns activity points, deal opportunity advances toward closure with technical risk mitigated

examples.name: Assessment Delivery

given: Partner has approved funding for a medium assessment
when: Partner delivers an IT assessment evaluating the customer's current environment against Red Hat technology capabilities

narratives.name: Technical Activity Delivery

Execute funded technical activities (proofs of concept, solution builds, workshops, assessments) within approved parameters, collect proof of performance, and submit claims.
Partner technical sellers deliver engagements, document customer outcomes, produce technical artifacts, and submit claims with proof of performance within quarterly deadlines.
Technical activities validate technology fit, advance deal progression, earn activity points for tier advancement, and produce reusable proof points for the TDP library.

activities.name: Manage Partner Deal Lifecycle
activities.description: Partner manages subscription renewals and expansion opportunities within registered deals while Red Hat tracks deal status, processes incentive claims, and coordinates renewal support.

Lifecycle intelligence tooling is accessible for renewal opportunity management

test.name: Deal lifecycle management verification
test.description: Verifies systematic renewal and expansion management for closed deals.
when: A closed deal approaches its renewal date within the 6-month to 30-day submission window
then: Incumbency renewal registration is submitted with proof of valuable engagement across required categories
Expansion opportunities are identified and evaluated for new deal registrations
Incumbency discount (15% Commercial / 5% Other) is applied for qualifying renewals

examples.name: Proactive Renewal with Expansion
examples.description: A partner converts a renewal conversation into a renewal plus expansion opportunity.
given: Partner has incumbency on a customer's $80K infrastructure subscription with renewal in 90 days, and lifecycle intelligence shows strong customer engagement
when: The partner initiates a strategic renewal conversation including a technology assessment of expansion opportunities aligned with Red Hat sales play themes
then: The renewal is processed with incumbency discount, the assessment identifies a $40K expansion into automation technology, a new cross-sell deal registration is submitted, and the customer's technology footprint grows

examples.name: At-Risk Renewal Recovery
examples.description: A partner uses lifecycle rewards to recover an at-risk renewal.
given: Lifecycle intelligence indicates declining customer engagement for a $50K subscription, and a competitor has initiated conversations with the customer
when: The partner deploys a funded workshop activity through lifecycle rewards to re-engage the customer
then: The workshop validates ongoing technology fit, the customer's concerns are addressed, the renewal is secured with incumbency discount, and the competitive threat is neutralized

narratives.name: Lifecycle and Renewal Management
narratives.description: How partners manage subscription renewals, incumbency protection, and expansion opportunities.

narrativeContexts.context: Partner has closed deals with established incumbency and approaching renewal dates requiring proactive lifecycle management.
Submit incumbency renewal registrations with proof of valuable engagement, identify expansion opportunities, and maintain customer relationships through the renewal cycle.

Document valuable engagement activities across four categories (Lifecycle Management, Net New Motions, Transformational Selling, Client Relationship Management), submit renewal registration within the timing window, and evaluate cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.
Renewal business is secured with incumbency discount, expansion opportunities are registered as new deals, and the partner's customer lifecycle management capability deepens.

activities.name: Measure Partner GTM Performance
activities.description: Red Hat tracks partner GTM execution metrics across demand generation, deal pipeline, and technical collaboration while partners provide campaign results, deal outcomes, and customer satisfaction data.

given: Partner has executed GTM activities across demand generation, deal registration, and technical collaboration over multiple quarters

test.name: GTM performance measurement verification
test.description: Verifies comprehensive performance review across all GTM dimensions.
when: Sufficient execution data has accumulated across demand generation, deal registration, and technical engagement activities
then: Partner GTM performance is measured across pipeline contribution, win rates, MDF ROI, and activity point accumulation
Data-driven optimization recommendations are generated for campaign mix, deal process, and technical engagement strategy
Cross-partner benchmarks inform ecosystem-level GTM program refinement

narratives.name: GTM Performance Measurement
narratives.description: How partner GTM execution data drives performance optimization and investment allocation.

narrativeContexts.context: Partner GTM execution produces data across demand generation, deal management, and technical collaboration that must be analyzed to optimize program investment and partner performance.
Track and analyze partner GTM performance metrics, benchmark against targets and ecosystem peers, and generate optimization recommendations.

Aggregate execution data across campaigns, deal registrations, and technical engagements; analyze ROI, conversion rates, and activity point contribution; identify high-performing patterns and underperforming areas.
Data-driven insights optimize MDF investment allocation, deal registration processes, lifecycle rewards activity mix, and cross-partner collaboration for continuous GTM improvement.
